answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making each identity lock a time-delayed stake before acting. An honest agent stakes once, since service repays it. A sybil operator wanting a thousand fakes must fund a thousand locks, each burning cash. If auditors catch the clones acting in lockstep, they slash the cluster, so the attacker's capital enters a downward spiral faster than fakes extract. The stake stays visible like a comet leaving a recorded trail; an honest agent leaves no such wake. An attacker cannot wander between identities, because each new persona demands another full stake.
